_doc: Rest position between turns and at the start of every move, in REAL arm degrees as the arm reports them (wrist_roll = this arm's sword-on-top value = sword on top). Shoulder lift -89 = the hard limit (further back rests on the board). Apply regenerates every move.

_help.joints.wrist: wrist pitch (deg; ~0 = hand in line with the forearm)
_help.joints.roll: wrist roll in real degrees: 76 = sword on top. Keep away from +/-180 (the servo cannot cross it)
